E2.label: asset_integrity
hand_requirements: exactly five digits per visible hand
one thumb in anatomically plausible opposition
four fingers with plausible length hierarchy
separate fingers without fusion or duplication
natural joint bends and relaxed spacing
wrist and palm orientation consistent with the pose
foot_requirements: footwear follows the actual foot volume
no duplicated toes or broken shoe-foot intersection when visible
ground contact matches body weight and stance

repair_policy: If an extremity error occurs while the rest of the asset passes, use a local patch round and lock identity, costume, composition, and lighting.
